in_marathi.name: Mohanraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mohanraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mohana' (delight) and 'raj' (rule). The name Mohanraj signifies the one who delights the gods and rules over their hearts. This name is often given to children who are believed to have the potential to bring happiness and joy to those around them.
